 Agreed Compliance Measures
 Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act) by a public office holder and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist them in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of the public office holder and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends. 
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity to further the private interests of my spouse, Mr. Jeff Nankivell, President and CEO of Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada, or give preferential treatment to the Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a reporting public office holder.
Accordingly, I have agreed to recuse myself from any discussion or decision in relation to my spouse or the Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter or decision-making processes which I or the screen administrator know or reasonably should know to affect my spouse’s private interests. I understand that recusal means  I must remove myself from  the room, physically or virtually as the case may be. 
This screen is co-administered by the Chief Compliance and Ethics Officer, the Corporate Secretary, and the Managing Director Indo-Pacific of the Singapore branch, to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decisions-making processes involving my spouse’s private interests, or the Asia Pacific Foundation of Canada’s private interests, unless the interest relates to a decision or matter that is of general application. I will participate in decisions or matters of general application and those that may affect my spouse’s private interests as a member of a broad class of persons unless those interests are disproportionate to the other members of the class.
Any matter that requires the President’s involvement will be brought to the attention of the Chair of the Board to identify the appropriate course of action.
The Minister of International Trade and its ministerial liaisons, the Board of Directors of the Export Development Canada and the Board of Directors of Development Finance Institute Canada, colleagues and necessary public servants have all been informed in writing about this conflict of interest screen. 
I have undertaken to inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner at the earliest opportunity of all changes of which I become aware that relate to or should form part of the above list of matters caught by this screen. 
In the event that I am made aware of a matter forming part of this screen or any such matter comes before me, I am required under section 21 of the Act to recuse myself from that matter. I must so inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and, where appropriate, make a public declaration of recusal pursuant to subsection 25(1) of the Act.
